meta.text: Thrown when a record fails schema validation before a write.

Match an `app.<verb>(pathArg, ...handlerArg)` call. Returns the verb, resolved paths, an optional
intra-file handler id, and the call's line span — or undefined if the call is not a route.

The path strings of a route's first argument: a string literal, or an array of string literals.
`'/api/users'` → ['/api/users']; `['/a','/b']` → ['/a','/b']; anything else → [].
Whether an expression is an inline handler body: an arrow function or function expression.
Edge factory. `by` = the lang extractor id; provenance EXTRACTED, confidence 1 (static graph).
Structural symbol shape — avoids exporting the extractor's private {@link LocalSymbol}.

Clamp an expression snippet to {@link EXPR_MAX_CHARS}, reporting whether the cap was hit so the
caller can stamp `exprTruncated` on the node. Single source of truth for expression fidelity —
every extractor routes its `expr`/`cursorQuery`/`whenSelector`/`errorMessage` capture through here.
A minimal tree-sitter-ish parser handle; concrete shape is backend-defined (M8 langs).
What a language extractor claims to resolve. Capability-honesty tests verify these (§5).
stereotypes survived onto the class symbols (the Spring pass mutates the symbol node).
the @Configuration class carries the config stereotype; the @Bean methods are its producers.
